text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the dance studio, Twin 
Turbo was taking a dance lesson along with 
Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hustle! Muscle!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hustle... muscle...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Pshuuuuuuu............

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ryannnn...! Turbo can't go on anymoreee...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, I can totally keep going! I 
didn't come all this way for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's push just a little harder and enjoy 
that refreshing feeling!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Refreshing?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just try to remember. That immense 
sense of fulfillment when you give a race 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I guarantee you'll feel just as fulfilled 
as if you crossed the finish line in 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just as much as crossing the finish 
line...??? Okay! Then Turbo's gonna do it! 
Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the dance lesson by Mejiro Ryan 
gained momentum—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hustle!! Muscle!! Focus more on your 
quadriceps!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Quadriceps femoriiis~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that!! Keep it up, support 
your body with your core muscles!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Abdominal army~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It feels so intense it's less like 
dancing and more like muscle training, 
butâ"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*, *wheeze*, *pant*, *pant*...――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eheheheh!! That felt soooo 
good~~~~~~~...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Call it true grit—Twin Turbo fired up in 
the face of adversity and pulled off the 
muscle-training dance lesson flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, were you watching?! How was 
Turbo?!

incredible she is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She really is an exceptionally talented 
student! It makes teaching her so 
rewarding!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, ehehe♪ Ryan, you can praise me even 
more, ya know~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that I would 
receive another dance lesson from Mejiro 
Ryan next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right! Then let's move on to the next 
phase! 'Ryan's Boot Camp'!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Ryan Boot Camp"!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We're going camping!? That sounds like so 
much fun♪ Let's do it, let's do it~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now that's some good spirit! Let's head 
over to the gym, then! We're gonna give it 
our all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Ryan Bootcamp" that took 
place was— well, it was basically pure 
muscle training.
